title: Two open-country tiles on the Shieldings plain are named with raw internal coordinates instead of prose, unlike every other room on the same plain (which all have evocative names like 'The Old Chantry Path' or 'Harrow's Approach'): 'the Shieldings 2,2' and 'the Shieldings 3,5'.
